fruits.extendedStory: Step out here and the ground simply opens. At 62,000 square metres this is the largest square in Lyon, a vast field of stone with little to interrupt it. All that space makes it the city's natural meeting place. The equestrian king at the centre serves as the landmark everyone steers toward.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Tritt heraus, und der Boden öffnet sich einfach. Mit 62.000 Quadratmetern ist dies der größte Platz Lyons, ein weites Steinfeld mit kaum etwas darauf. So viel Raum macht ihn zum selbstverständlichen Treffpunkt der Stadt. Der Reiterkönig in der Mitte ist das Merkzeichen, auf das alle zusteuern.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Step out here and the ground simply opens. At 62,000 square metres this is the largest square in Lyon, a vast field of stone with little to interrupt it. All that space makes it the city's natural meeting place. The equestrian king at the centre serves as the landmark everyone steers toward.

localizedStory.de: In der Mitte steht ein Reiterstandbild von Louis XIV, der König als römischer Kaiser hoch zu Pferd.
localizedStory.en: At its centre stands an equestrian statue of Louis XIV, the king cast on horseback as a Roman emperor.

fruits.name: Place Bellecour
fruits.story: At its centre stands an equestrian statue of Louis XIV, the king cast on horseback as a Roman emperor.

fruits.extendedStory: Work on this cathedral began in 1175, yet it was not opened until 1480. Long lifetimes of masons passed while it slowly rose. Its builder was Jacques de Beaujeu, and its early parts follow the Romanesque manner. That is the rounded-arch style of its early years, still visible low in the walls.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau dieser Kathedrale begann 1175, doch erst 1480 wurde sie eröffnet. Über viele Menschenleben hinweg wuchs sie langsam empor. Ihr Baumeister war Jacques de Beaujeu, und die frühen Teile folgen der romanischen Bauweise. Das ist der Rundbogenstil der frühen Jahre, unten in den Mauern noch zu sehen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Work on this cathedral began in 1175, yet it was not opened until 1480. Long lifetimes of masons passed while it slowly rose. Its builder was Jacques de Beaujeu, and its early parts follow the Romanesque manner. That is the rounded-arch style of its early years, still visible low in the walls.

localizedStory.de: Rund 44 Meter hoch überragt diese Kathedrale die Altstadt und ist Johannes dem Täufer geweiht.
localizedStory.en: Rising about 44 metres over the Old Town, this cathedral is dedicated to John the Baptist.

fruits.name: Cathédrale Saint-Jean
fruits.story: Rising about 44 metres over the Old Town, this cathedral is dedicated to John the Baptist.

fruits.extendedStory: The sculptor was Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi, and the fountain carries his name rather than a saint's or a king's. Two dates are attached to it, 1888 and 1889, and the records do not agree. About six metres of it rises from the Place des Terreaux. Walk right around it, because a fountain this size is meant to be read from every side.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bildhauer war Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi, und der Brunnen trägt seinen Namen, nicht den eines Heiligen oder Königs. Zwei Jahreszahlen hängen an ihm, 1888 und 1889, und die Quellen sind sich uneins. Rund sechs Meter erheben sich über der Place des Terreaux. Geh einmal ganz herum, denn ein Brunnen dieser Größe will von allen Seiten gelesen werden.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The sculptor was Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi, and the fountain carries his name rather than a saint's or a king's. Two dates are attached to it, 1888 and 1889, and the records do not agree. About six metres of it rises from the Place des Terreaux. Walk right around it, because a fountain this size is meant to be read from every side.

localizedStory.de: Rund 6 Meter hoch steht dieser Brunnen auf der Place des Terreaux und trägt den Namen seines Bildhauers Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi.
localizedStory.en: Standing about 6 metres tall on the Place des Terreaux, this fountain carries the name of its sculptor, Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi.

fruits.name: Fontaine Bartholdi
fruits.story: Standing about 6 metres tall on the Place des Terreaux, this fountain carries the name of its sculptor, Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi.

fruits.extendedStory: The bridge went up quickly. Work started in 1949 and it was inaugurated the next year, in 1950. René Dardel is the name attached to its design. One year from groundwork to opening day is brisk for a river crossing. You can see it in the result, which is plain and direct with no decoration at all.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Brücke entstand schnell. Die Arbeiten begannen 1949, und schon im Jahr darauf, 1950, wurde sie eingeweiht. Der Entwurf trägt den Namen René Dardel. Ein Jahr vom Baubeginn bis zum Eröffnungstag ist zügig für einen Flussübergang. Man sieht es dem Ergebnis an: schlicht und direkt, ohne jeden Zierrat.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The bridge went up quickly. Work started in 1949 and it was inaugurated the next year, in 1950. René Dardel is the name attached to its design. One year from groundwork to opening day is brisk for a river crossing. You can see it in the result, which is plain and direct with no decoration at all.

localizedStory.de: Von René Dardel entworfen, wurde diese Brücke 1949 begonnen und 1950 eröffnet.
localizedStory.en: Designed by René Dardel, this bridge was started in 1949 and opened in 1950.

fruits.name: Pont de la Feuillée
fruits.story: Designed by René Dardel, this bridge was started in 1949 and opened in 1950.

fruits.extendedStory: The courtyard is named after the Voraces, a group of silk-weavers. They took part in Lyon's uprising of 1848, and their trade filled these tall buildings. The buildings were raised around 1840, high enough for the weavers' work. Standing here, you sense the busy weaving world that once filled these walls.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Innenhof ist nach den Voraces benannt, einer Gruppe von Seidenwebern. Sie waren am Aufstand von Lyon im Jahr 1848 beteiligt, und ihr Handwerk füllte diese hohen Häuser. Um 1840 wurden die Gebäude errichtet, hoch genug für die Arbeit der Weber. Wer hier steht, ahnt die geschäftige Welt des Webens, die einst diese Mauern erfüllte.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The courtyard is named after the Voraces, a group of silk-weavers. They took part in Lyon's uprising of 1848, and their trade filled these tall buildings. The buildings were raised around 1840, high enough for the weavers' work. Standing here, you sense the busy weaving world that once filled these walls.

localizedStory.de: Tritt in den Innenhof und sieh die unverkennbare Treppe, die im Freien im Zickzack die Wände hinaufsteigt.
localizedStory.en: Step into the courtyard for its unmistakable staircase, zig-zagging up in the open across the walls.

fruits.name: Cour des Voraces
fruits.story: Step into the courtyard for its unmistakable staircase, zig-zagging up in the open across the walls.

fruits.extendedStory: Gothic Revival means exactly what it sounds like. Architects went back to the pointed arches and tall windows of the Middle Ages and built them fresh. Pierre Bossan did that here from 1848, and the result can fool the eye at a glance. The church is dedicated to Saint George, and it wears its borrowed age lightly.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Neugotik heißt genau das, wonach es klingt. Architekten griffen die Spitzbögen und hohen Fenster des Mittelalters wieder auf und bauten sie neu. Pierre Bossan tat das hier ab 1848, und das Ergebnis täuscht das Auge zunächst. Geweiht ist die Kirche dem heiligen Georg, und sie trägt ihr geliehenes Alter leicht.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Gothic Revival means exactly what it sounds like. Architects went back to the pointed arches and tall windows of the Middle Ages and built them fresh. Pierre Bossan did that here from 1848, and the result can fool the eye at a glance. The church is dedicated to Saint George, and it wears its borrowed age lightly.

localizedStory.de: Diese Kirche wirkt mittelalterlich, stammt aber von 1848: Pierre Bossan baute sie im neugotischen Stil.
localizedStory.en: This church looks medieval but dates from 1848: Pierre Bossan built it in the Gothic Revival style.

fruits.name: Église Saint-Georges
fruits.story: This church looks medieval but dates from 1848: Pierre Bossan built it in the Gothic Revival style.

fruits.extendedStory: The square takes its name from the Celestine monks, who founded a convent here in 1407. It was gone by 1778, and a theatre went up in its place, opening in 1792. Fire took that theatre in 1871 and again in 1877. The Lyon architect Gaspard André was given the rebuilding, and it reopened in 1881 just as it had been. Buren's piece went in beneath the square on 20 November 1994, and it was made to stay.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Platz trägt den Namen der Cölestinermönche, die hier 1407 ein Kloster gründeten. 1778 war es verschwunden, und an seiner Stelle entstand ein Theater, das 1792 öffnete. 1871 und noch einmal 1877 fiel dieses Theater einem Brand zum Opfer. Der Lyoner Architekt Gaspard André bekam den Wiederaufbau, und 1881 öffnete es wieder, genau wie zuvor. Burens Werk kam am 20. November 1994 unter den Platz und sollte dort bleiben.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The square takes its name from the Celestine monks, who founded a convent here in 1407. It was gone by 1778, and a theatre went up in its place, opening in 1792. Fire took that theatre in 1871 and again in 1877. The Lyon architect Gaspard André was given the rebuilding, and it reopened in 1881 just as it had been. Buren's piece went in beneath the square on 20 November 1994, and it was made to stay.

localizedStory.de: Auf diesem Platz steht ein Periskop. Schau hinein, und Daniel Burens Kunstwerk liegt unter dir in der Tiefgarage.
localizedStory.en: There is a periscope on this square. Look down it and Daniel Buren's artwork is under your feet, in the car park.

fruits.name: Place des Célestins
fruits.story: There is a periscope on this square. Look down it and Daniel Buren's artwork is under your feet, in the car park.

fruits.extendedStory: This square was laid out in 1980, in the years when Lyon's métro was being dug beneath the city. It takes its name from Louis Pradel, and today it feels like an outdoor gallery. A fountain plays here, with sculptures by Ipoustéguy set around it. The one people point to is César's skater, 'Le Patineur'.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Dieser Platz wurde 1980 angelegt, in den Jahren, als Lyons Métro unter der Stadt gegraben wurde. Seinen Namen trägt er nach Louis Pradel, und heute wirkt er wie eine Galerie unter freiem Himmel. Ein Brunnen plätschert hier, und ringsum stehen Skulpturen von Ipoustéguy. Worauf die Leute zeigen, ist Césars Schlittschuhläufer 'Le Patineur'.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This square was laid out in 1980, in the years when Lyon's métro was being dug beneath the city. It takes its name from Louis Pradel, and today it feels like an outdoor gallery. A fountain plays here, with sculptures by Ipoustéguy set around it. The one people point to is César's skater, 'Le Patineur'.

localizedStory.de: Halte Ausschau nach Césars Skulptur 'Le Patineur', dem Schlittschuhläufer, neben einem Brunnen und Werken von Ipoustéguy.
localizedStory.en: Look for César's sculpture 'Le Patineur', the skater, sharing this square with a fountain and works by Ipoustéguy.

fruits.name: Place Louis Pradel
fruits.story: Look for César's sculpture 'Le Patineur', the skater, sharing this square with a fountain and works by Ipoustéguy.

fruits.extendedStory: Beneath this Gothic church lies a quiet crypt. It keeps the memory of Christians of Lyon from the year 177, among them Sainte Blandine. Their story has been held safe here for a very long time. The church itself owes part of its design to the architect Philibert de l'Orme. Those old walls have sheltered that memory ever since.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Unter dieser gotischen Kirche liegt eine stille Krypta. Sie bewahrt das Andenken an Christen aus Lyon aus dem Jahr 177, unter ihnen Sainte Blandine. Diese Erinnerung wird hier schon sehr lange gehütet. Die Kirche verdankt einen Teil ihres Entwurfs dem Architekten Philibert de l’Orme. Die alten Mauern hüten dieses Andenken seither.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Beneath this Gothic church lies a quiet crypt. It keeps the memory of Christians of Lyon from the year 177, among them Sainte Blandine. Their story has been held safe here for a very long time. The church itself owes part of its design to the architect Philibert de l'Orme. Those old walls have sheltered that memory ever since.

localizedStory.de: Blick hinauf zum Nordturm: Seine gotische Spitze ist aus rosa Backstein gebaut, unverkennbar vor dem Himmel.
localizedStory.en: Look up at the north tower: its Gothic spire is built of pink brick, unmistakable against the sky.

fruits.name: Église Saint-Nizier
fruits.story: Look up at the north tower: its Gothic spire is built of pink brick, unmistakable against the sky.
